name: Wolf Companion
theme: A bonded Nordic ranger who fights beside a trained gray wolf, using shared tracking instincts, coordinated movement, protective commands, and precise ranged attacks to control the battlefield as a two-member hunting pack.
visualIdentity: Layered forest-brown ranger leathers with muted-green and charcoal accents, gray wolf-fur mantle, compact ashwood shortbow, practical iron-edged seax, companion whistle, travel pouches, dark iron fittings, durable Nordic boots, and restrained pale-blue pack-bond energy.
consistency: Use the same face, hair, ranger-leather silhouette, fur mantle pattern, shortbow design, seax design, companion gear arrangement, wolf appearance, wolf harness, wolf markings, proportions, and color palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.name: Pack Flank
starterAbilities.description: Coordinate an attack with the wolf companion to pressure and surround the target.

starterAbilities.name: Guardian Howl
starterAbilities.description: The wolf emits a protective howl that bolsters nearby allies.

starterAbilities.name: Shared Hunt
starterAbilities.description: Hunter and companion focus on the same target, improving pursuit and accuracy.
